$schema_example.effort: Optional. S (under an hour or two) | M (a session) | L (several sessions, plan first)
$schema_example.blockedReason: null unless status is blocked, then why
$schema_example.notes: Extra context a fresh session/agent would need — why this exists, constraints.
$schema_example.acceptanceCriteria: Optional. How to verify it's done, agreed before starting (tests, a Playwright check, a command's output) — what an independent reviewer checks.
